554 { \
555  name.length = snprintf(name.value, CL_MAX_NAME_LENGTH - 1, __VA_ARGS__);\
556  name.value[CL_MIN(name.length, CL_MAX_NAME_LENGTH - 1)] = '\0'; \
557 }while(0)
